observations.statement: Pathspec trap that false-cleans write-scope checks: git wildcard pathspecs must match the FULL path, so '.ufo/evidence/round-5[0-7]' (the exact form printed in the round's contract prose), ':(glob)...round-5[0-7]', and '...round-5[0-7]/' ALL return empty against a real 4-file delta; only '...round-5[0-7]/**' returns the files. A scripted no-changes check using the naive form would report clean falsely. This seat's first check did exactly that and was caught only by cross-checking git log --name-only.
observations.evidence: receipt 04: three empty naive/glob/trailing-slash runs vs explicit enumeration returning 4 A files vs '.ufo/evidence/round-5[0-7]/**' returning the same 4.
observations.attribution: Observed directly. Smallest remediation: scripted evidence checks must append '/**' (or enumerate round dirs explicitly), never trust the bare bracket pathspec's empty output.
